input.body:
label: bug
file: none

Thanks for the report. This looks like a timezone-handling bug in the scheduled summary email job: users in timezones behind UTC (like Sydney) receive their Monday summary a day late, while users ahead of or close to UTC (like London) get it on time. This suggests the scheduler may be computing "Monday" based on a reference timezone (e.g. UTC or the server's local time) rather than each account's configured timezone, or there's an off-by-one-day error in the date boundary calculation for timezones with a large negative UTC offset. We were unable to pinpoint the exact file via code search, so engineering will need to locate the scheduling/cron job responsible for triggering the weekly summary email and verify it uses the per-account timezone consistently when determining the send date, not just the send time.
